model.name: model
model.description: Foundation model size for mace_mp(): 'small', 'medium', or 'large'.

model_paths.name: model_paths
model_paths.description: Path to custom MACE model file (.model). Used with MACECalculator instead of mace_mp().

dispersion.name: dispersion
dispersion.description: Enable D3 dispersion correction on top of MACE energy/forces.

compute_stress.name: compute_stress
compute_stress.description: Whether to compute stress tensor (periodic systems only).

energy_units_to_eV.name: energy_units_to_eV
energy_units_to_eV.description: Conversion factor from model energy units to eV. Default 1.0 (MACE models output eV).

length_units_to_A.name: length_units_to_A
length_units_to_A.description: Conversion factor from model length units to Angstrom. Default 1.0.

fmax.name: fmax
fmax.description: Maximum force convergence threshold in eV/Angstrom for geometry optimization.

opt_trajectory.name: opt_trajectory
opt_trajectory.description: Filename for optimization trajectory output (JSONL format).

relax_cell.name: relax_cell
relax_cell.description: Whether to relax the unit cell (variable-cell optimization).

cell_filter.name: cell_filter
cell_filter.description: ASE cell filter for variable-cell relaxation: 'FrechetCellFilter', 'ExpCellFilter', or 'UnitCellFilter'.

hydrostatic_strain.name: hydrostatic_strain
hydrostatic_strain.description: If True, constrain cell optimization to hydrostatic (isotropic) strain only.

scalar_pressure.name: scalar_pressure
scalar_pressure.description: External pressure in GPa for variable-cell relaxation.

cell_factor.name: cell_factor
cell_factor.description: Scaling factor for cell degrees of freedom in the filter. Default varies by filter.

md_nsteps.name: md_nsteps
md_nsteps.description: Number of MD steps to run.

md_temperature.name: md_temperature
md_temperature.description: Target temperature in Kelvin for NVT/NPT ensembles.

md_friction.name: md_friction
md_friction.description: Langevin friction coefficient in 1/fs for NVT ensemble.

md_init_temperature.name: md_init_temperature
md_init_temperature.description: Initial temperature for velocity initialization. Defaults to md_temperature.

npt_pressure.name: npt_pressure
npt_pressure.description: Target pressure in bar for NPT ensemble (default 1 atm).

npt_ttime.name: npt_ttime
npt_ttime.description: Thermostat time constant in fs for NPT.

npt_pfactor.name: npt_pfactor
npt_pfactor.description: Barostat time constant (derived from bulk modulus). None = ASE auto.

npt_mask.name: npt_mask
npt_mask.description: Pressure coupling mask for anisotropic NPT (e.g. '1 1 1 0 0 0' for isotropic).

md_log_interval.name: md_log_interval
md_log_interval.description: Interval (in steps) for writing trajectory frames.

md_trajectory.name: md_trajectory
md_trajectory.description: Filename for MD trajectory output (JSONL format).

charge.name: charge
charge.description: Total system charge (used for initial magmom setup). MACE itself is charge-neutral but ASE may use this.

write_final_structure.name: write_final_structure
write_final_structure.description: Write final optimized/MD structure to final_structure.json.

MACE_DEVICE.name: MACE_DEVICE
MACE_DEVICE.description: Override compute device via environment variable.

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.name: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.description: Restrict visible CUDA devices for GPU execution.

OMP_NUM_THREADS.name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
OMP_NUM_THREADS.description: OpenMP thread count for CPU execution.

PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK.name: PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK
PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK.description: Enable MPS fallback for Apple Silicon GPU execution.
